Name: Shane To Randy Marsh
Author: peaachdew
Description:
[b]description:[/b]
this is a stardew valley mod that replaces shane with randy marsh from south park. it will change his name, sprite, and portrait to match randy. however, it does not affect any gameplay, it simply renames and retextures shane. it also changes shanes birthday (spring 20) to match randy's cannon birthday (spring 1). compatable with slightly cuter character sprites.

[b]known issues﻿:[/b]
[list]
[*]the name change will only work when language is set to english. however the sprite will work no matter what language is selected
[*]this does not affect gameplay so all dialouge, cutscenes, storyline, etc is the same as base game
[/list]
[b]installation:[/b]
1. requires the latest version of content patcher & smapi.
2. download this mod.
3. extract the mod folder into your stardew valley\mods directory.
4. run the game using smapi.

if the mod does not work, it is possible you have other mods installed interfering. mods that replace the sprites or portraits of shane will interfere, so please remove those before using this mod.
